seoKeywords: Breathing Exercise App for Sleep, Focus & Relaxation | Free Binaural Beats
seoDescription: Vuko is a free breathing-exercise and sleep & relaxation web app. It detects your breathing in real time through the microphone and auto-tunes binaural beats to help you relax, de-stress, focus, meditate, and fall into deep sleep. No sign-up, no ads, open source — runs right in your browser.
